body:
# Visible Blue Ice Resource Pack

Visible Blue Ice is a Minecraft resource pack that makes Blue Ice blocks much easier to spot by giving them a brighter, more noticeable blue texture while keeping the vanilla style. It is useful for players searching for blue ice glaciers and icebergs in frozen ocean biomes. The pack changes only the appearance of Blue Ice and does not affect gameplay, performance, or block properties.

Features:

Brighter and more visible Blue Ice texture.
Keeps the default Minecraft look (16x resolution).
Helps players find Blue Ice glaciers faster.
Works as a lightweight utility resource pack.
